title: 4180 Larkspur Lane
subtitle: High-risk narcotics warrant
briefing: TOC: Element, this is a high-risk search warrant on a single-family home at 4180 Larkspur Lane. Narcotics believes it's a fentanyl pressing operation run by the Coyle brothers.

Expect three to five armed suspects. Surveillance put a lookout in the garage, and there's a shotgun registered to the address. The homeowner, an elderly man, hasn't been seen in a week. Treat him as a possible hostage.
The house has a ground floor and a basement. Informants say the bedroom doors may be rigged. Mirror before you open anything you're unsure of.

Objectives: arrest or neutralize every suspect, rescue every civilian, and secure the ledger, the pill press and the product. Report everyone you secure or neutralize to TOC. Rules of engagement: deadly force only against a suspect who is visibly armed and not surrendering. Bring order to chaos.

rooms.name: Front Yard
rooms.desc: A patchy lawn and a sagging porch. The blinds are drawn and you can hear a TV inside.

rooms.name: Driveway
rooms.desc: An oil-stained driveway beside the garage. A side door leads into the garage.

rooms.name: Back Yard
rooms.desc: An overgrown yard full of trash bags. The back door opens into the kitchen.

rooms.name: Living Room
rooms.desc: A loud TV, a stained sectional, and pizza boxes everywhere. An archway leads to the kitchen and a doorway to the hall.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.desc: Pots are steaming on the stove and the counters are covered in baggies and digital scales.

rooms.name: Garage
rooms.desc: A car up on blocks and work benches covered in powder. A pill press sits under a tarp.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.desc: A narrow hall lined with family photos that have been knocked crooked. Doors lead to the bedrooms, the bathroom, and the basement stairs.

rooms.name: Master Bedroom
rooms.desc: A mattress on the floor, a gun safe hanging open, and a desk stacked with paperwork.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.desc: A cramped bathroom. The shower curtain is pulled shut.

rooms.name: Spare Bedroom
rooms.desc: It smells stale. A dining chair sits in the middle of the room, with rope on the floor around it.

rooms.name: Basement
rooms.desc: Plastic sheeting, box fans, and folding tables covered in drums of chemicals. This is the lab.

npcs.desc: elderly man tied to a chair
